env GIT_EDITOR=true

# Linear history where each commit rewrites f; a later mainx commit makes every
# revert of a/b/c conflict.
exec git init
exec git checkout -b main
exec git config user.email tester@email.com
exec git config user.name Testeur

cp f-base f
exec git add f
exec git commit -m base
cp f-a f
exec git commit -am a
cp f-b f
exec git commit -am b
cp f-c f
exec git commit -am c
cp f-x f
exec git commit -am mainx

# Build gitmux and go back to work dir.
cd $GITMUX_DIR
go build -o $WORK/gitmux .
cd $WORK

# Multi-commit revert pauses on step 1/3 with a conflict.
! exec git revert --no-edit HEAD~1 HEAD~2 HEAD~3
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
stdout '\[revert\] main 1/3 conflict 1\|C1'

# Resolve and continue: step advances to 2/3.
cp resolved f
exec git add f
! exec git revert --continue
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
stdout '\[revert\] main 2/3 conflict 1\|C1'

# Abort: sequencer metadata is cleared and main is restored.
exec git revert --abort
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
! stdout '\[revert\]'
stdout 'main'

# A conflict-free multi-revert runs to completion and leaves no metadata.
exec git checkout -b clean-revert
cp f-g g
exec git add g
exec git commit -m pg
cp f-h h
exec git add h
exec git commit -m qh
exec git revert --no-edit HEAD~1 HEAD~2
exec ./gitmux --cfg gitmux.yml
! stdout '\[revert\]'
stdout 'clean-revert'

-- .gitignore --
.gitignore
.gopath
.tmp
gitmux
gitmux.yml
f-base
f-a
f-b
f-c
f-x
f-g
f-h
resolved

-- f-base --
base
-- f-a --
aaa
-- f-b --
bbb
-- f-c --
ccc
-- f-x --
main-x
-- f-g --
g-content
-- f-h --
h-content
-- resolved --
resolved-content
-- gitmux.yml --
tmux:
    symbols:
        branch: ""
        conflict: "C"
    styles:
        clear: ""
        state: ""
        branch: ""
        divergence: ""
        conflict: ""
        staged: ""
        op: ""
    layout: [branch, "|", op, "|", flags]
